# netactuate_vpc_inbound_firewall (Resource)

Manages a VPC's IPv4 and IPv6 inbound firewalls. Create it with depends_on on the VPC's inbound netactuate_vpc_gateway_firewall_rule resources: the firewall needs at least one inbound rule before it can be turned on. This resource owns both inbound flags: it sets ipv4 and ipv6 as configured (both are required), and destroying it turns both off. Leave firewall_ipv4_inbound and firewall_ipv6_inbound unset on netactuate_vpc while it is in use.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_vpc_gateway_firewall_rule" "http" {
  vpc_id      = 12345
  ip_version  = 4
  direction   = "inbound"
  protocol    = "TCP"
  description = "Allow HTTP"
  port_start  = 80
  port_end    = 80
}

resource "netactuate_vpc_inbound_firewall" "example" {
  vpc_id = 12345
  ipv4   = true
  ipv6   = false

  depends_on = [netactuate_vpc_gateway_firewall_rule.http]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipv4` (Boolean) Whether the IPv4 inbound firewall is on. true needs an IPv4 inbound rule.
- `ipv6` (Boolean) Whether the IPv6 inbound firewall is on. true needs an IPv6 inbound rule; false turns it off.
- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID whose inbound firewall is managed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_vpc_inbound_firewall.example 12345
```
